name: Solage, Auberge Collection
insider_take: This eco-luxury resort sits on 22 acres where natural hot springs bubble beneath your feet, creating Napa Valley's most wellness-focused wine country retreat.
whats_special: Solage features the only resort in Napa with a geothermal mineral pool sourced from natural underground springs. The property boasts its own organic garden that supplies ingredients directly to Solbar restaurant, plus a world-class spa utilizing locally-sourced mud from nearby volcanic ash deposits.
pro_tip: Book spa treatments for late afternoon - the geothermal pools are most relaxing at sunset, and you'll avoid the midday crowds while enjoying golden hour views of the Palisades Mountains.
dont_miss: The nearby Old Faithful Geyser (one of only three in the world) erupts every 30 minutes just 2 miles away, and Calistoga's famous hot air balloon rides launch at dawn from fields visible from your room - offering unparalleled aerial views of America's most prestigious wine region.
pros: Award-winning geothermal spa with natural hot springs
Premium Napa Valley wine country location in Calistoga
Contemporary luxury resort design with modern amenities
